title: Technology Implements a Generic Pattern
summary: Every technology object implements at least one technology-neutral pattern, so technology knowledge never stands on its own.
body_markdown:
# Technology Implements a Generic Pattern

## Rule

For every object of type `technology`: at least one `implements` relationship to a `pattern`. Machine-readable in `rule`; evaluated by `dakb.py rules` and during validation (W100).

## Rationale

[[Technology-Neutral Architecture First]]: technology-specific knowledge must reference the generic concept or pattern it realizes.

## Enforcement

Warning during validation. Scope today: this knowledge graph. The same rule shape is intended for customer architectures (architecture-as-code).

## Exceptions

None known.
